pattern: IM-T04 tenant disputes the appointment date, plus a new electrical safety report in the same call (bang, burning smell, scorched and warm cooker switch); ES emergency outranks the date question
notes: Mutation of event 021 (the tenant's call about the date). The original first paragraph is kept word for word (the To field is set to Agency / system, since the call now reports a fault to the agency); a second paragraph is added: at lunchtime the oven banged, there was a strong burning smell from the back of the cooker, the kitchen sockets tripped, the wall around the cooker switch is scorched and the switch plate felt warm; she switched the cooker off at the wall switch and reset the trip so the other sockets work. History truncated after event 021 (Saturday 30 August 2025, 14:02). Policy treats burning electrics as an emergency. Expected: safety advice to the tenant now (keep the cooker off, switch off the cooker circuit at the consumer unit, do not use or reset it, leave and call 999 if smoke, heat or burning returns), an urgent electrician to make the cooker circuit and switch safe today rather than waiting for the oven appointment, escalation to a human (out-of-hours emergency, no electrician on file, landlord to be told), and the date question still answered as being confirmed with the provider.
